title: multi-session-dev lane plan
description: Lead-authored plan consumed by lane_plan.py, session_runner.py and integrate.py. Validation rules beyond types live in lane_plan.py.

repo.description: Absolute repo path. Defaults to the Git root of the current directory.

target_branch.description: Lead task branch that lane branches merge into. Never main/develop directly.

commit_allowed.description: From the caller's input contract. Write lanes require true.

rules_to_read.description: Repo-relative docs every lane reads first.

resources.description: DB/Docker/ports a lane may use. Lanes must not start anything else.

role.description: Capability name from references/worker-capabilities.md or a project worker name.

owned_paths.description: Repo-relative paths or globs this lane may modify. Required and non-overlapping for write lanes.

advisory.description: Review lanes only: FAIL does not block integration.
